sentence_stem: I didn't reply to your text message because
full_sentence: I didn't reply to your text message because my phone battery was dead.

options.text: I really liked your new photo.
options.why_wrong: This is a comment about a photo, not a reason for missing the reply, so it does not complete the 'because' clause.

options.text: so I was happy to answer.
options.why_wrong: 'So' cannot follow 'because', and the clause says the speaker was happy to answer, which contradicts not replying.
This is a future plan, not a reason for the past action, so it does not explain the cause.

explanation: 'Because' introduces the reason for an action. After it, we need a clause that explains why the speaker did not reply, so the completion must give a real cause.
translation: Mesajınıza telefonumun şarjı bittiği için cevap vermedim.
